name: Balanced Leech
imitates: A leech that hangs level in the water instead of nose-down, usually fished under an indicator in stillwater; colors are endless.
recipe: Senyo's Fusion Dub or STS Trilobal Dub
Same dubbing, spun in a loop

steps.text: Cut a push pin to about 5/8 in. and slide the bead on backwards, wide opening toward the pin head.
Start thread behind the bead against the pin head and build a ramp to lock the bead, then whip finish and cut the thread.
Secure the pin and bead on top of the hook with snug (not tight) wraps so you can still slide it, then cut the thread free.
Hang the hook from tippet through the eye to check the balance and slide the pin until the fly hangs nearly level.
Re-start the thread near the barb and tie in a small pinch of dubbing on top of the shank for the tail.
Fold the dubbing back on itself to form the tail and wrap over the fold to lock it.
Make a 5-6 in. dubbing loop and spin a sparse, even rope of the same dubbing, picking out trapped fibers.
Wrap the dubbing rope forward from the bend to the bead, stroking the fibers back after each turn, then tie off, whip finish and trim.
Finished Balanced Leech: sparse shaggy body and tail behind the bead.
